assumptions: The uploaded Organization Agent Mesh v1.0.0 package is the seed baseline.
completion_definition: Identity, capability, communication, concurrency, deployment package, test and documentation controls are synchronized and exact-SHA release-gate validated.
constraints: Do not modify peer project repositories from this project
Do not silently elevate agent authority
Slack is an optional scheduled-task transport and not canonical project state
Recursive learning may observe peers read-only but may graft changes only into this project after local review
Preserve at least 20 percent verified repository/artifact capacity for essential writes when a hard limit is known
Unknown repository/artifact capacity must never be interpreted as unlimited
Current human project intent and the local identity lock must be validated before continuation state becomes actionable
Durable persistence adapters must preserve atomic lease and compare-and-set semantics or fail closed
Mutation authority must be derived from an ACTIVE bound execution session, not caller-supplied identity strings
Canonical identifiers must be validated without lossy sanitization
desired_outcome: A reusable, fail-closed, project-scoped communication and deployment control plane suitable for autonomous multi-project operation.
non_goals: Implement domain logic for Duo Open
Create shared mutable state between projects
Use Slack as canonical accepted state
Create a central controller that may mutate peer projects
problem_statement: Harden the Organization Agent Mesh inter-agent communication architecture for safe simultaneous operation of multiple unrelated projects while preserving project-specific autonomy and synchronized deployable agent packages.
prohibited_actions: Write to any peer repository during self-enhancement observation
Guess project identity for mutating operations
Authorize mutation from an unverified caller-supplied project_id
Lossily sanitize canonical identifiers into colliding keys
Guess a Slack destination for scheduled-task delivery
Invent a provider hard limit or treat an unknown capacity limit as unlimited
Allow an unbound agent to mutate project state
Silently accept a stale state version
Allow a restarted execution instance to inherit an earlier instance-owned lease
success_criteria: Current project intent and identity lock are validated before continuation state or mutable work
Concurrent projects cannot accidentally route or mutate across namespaces
Unbound or forged caller identity cannot authorize mutation
Child agents inherit project identity and cannot escalate parent capabilities
Canonical resource identifiers cannot collide through normalization
Project-scoped leases recover without stale execution-instance inheritance
One project can pause or drain without stopping unrelated projects
Duplicate deliveries are safe no-ops and invalid/expired messages remain non-executable quarantine evidence
Every deployable runtime/schema/protocol dependency is captured by the package dependency map
PRIMARY, MANAGER and RESEARCH packages are reproducible, role-correct and traceable to one exact source revision
A third project can adopt the protocol without code changes to the core
